summary: The pre-sign worker ends whatever a run left in its process group (a test's stray background process) as soon as st-test exits, before it reads the run's log, so nothing can write to the log after st-test's summary. An attempt that signed nothing because the tree edits every lane is recorded as lane_edit_not_signed, not as worker_signed_lane_edit.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes.
